edits.after:
name = "iso_linalg_mod"
version = "0.1.0"
license = "license"
author = "Euler-37"
copyright = "Copyright 2022, Euler-37"

[build]
auto-executables = true
auto-tests = true
auto-examples = true
link = [
    "openblas",
]

[install]
library = false

[fortran]
implicit-external = true

scope: Typed LAPACK interfaces. The checked real64 main verifies a matrix inverse residual, determinant, known eigenvalues, eigenpair residuals and orthonormality for a symmetric 3-by-3 tridiagonal matrix. Complex, single-precision and other BLAS/LAPACK wrappers are not covered. Legacy implicit external interfaces are explicitly enabled in the pinned package manifest.

license_status.notes: The pinned archive has a placeholder license field and no root license file or license notice found in the reviewed source/README. No license terms are inferred from the placeholder.

compatibility_edits: Enable implicit-external in the package manifest for the original Fortran 77 LAPACK/BLAS calling interfaces. No numerical source or formulas changed.
